name: Brainbees Solutions Ltd

ar26.what: Annual report FY26 with notice of the 16th AGM (22-Sep-2026); accounts approved 26-May-2026

segments.imc: India multi-channel: the FirstCry website and app plus 1,188 FirstCry/BabyHug modern stores (651 franchise, 537 company-owned at Jun-26, incl. stores run by Digital Age and franchisees), 2.1 mn SKUs from 7,900+ brands, home brands (BabyHug and others, >58% of India multi-channel GMV in FY26) and own manufacturing of home-brand products; 78% of GMV online, 22% offline (Q1FY27).
segments.intl: International: FirstCry.ae (UAE, live Oct-2019) and FirstCry.sa (Saudi Arabia, live Aug-2022), largely online; average order value 4.1x India.
segments.gb: Globalbees: a roll-up of D2C brands (home improvement & utilities, home appliances, health & personal care, active, lifestyle & accessories) sold mostly on marketplaces; FirstCry owns 51.68%; last brand acquisition Sep-2022; non-core brands exited by Q1FY27.
segments.oth: Others: FirstCry Intellitots preschools (partner/franchise model in 190+ cities; more than double the 208 preschools of FY24 by FY26).

fy26.exceptionalNote: Impairment of Globalbees brand intangibles (₹19.6 cr net of tax), write-off of non-core Globalbees inventory (₹35.6 cr) and other items, offset by a ₹24.0 cr gain on remeasuring consideration payable to Globalbees brand founders (FY25: ₹197 cr impairment, ₹174 cr gain).

guidanceAndCall.what: India multi-channel growth to stay "elevated": revenue growth improved every quarter from 7.5% (Q1FY26) to 17.7% (Q1FY27); offline GMV +15% after re-aligning store assortment from width to depth.

Gross margin: India multi-channel lost ~280bp YoY in Q4FY26 (diaper price war, ~15% of GMV; rupee depreciation and crude-linked input costs in own manufacturing) and recovered 20bp in Q1. Input costs to be fully passed on by end-Q2FY27; diaper intensity easing in Jul-Aug-2026, normalisation over 4-6 quarters from Q3FY26; the H2FY27 YoY margin gap should "dramatically reduce".
About 90-100 net new stores in FY27 (expansion largely paused in FY26); FY28 "even better".

RocketBees (own last-mile network): 72 cities and >50% of online shipments by Jun-26, ~20% faster delivery. FirstCry Qwik (2-3 hour delivery): 12 cities, ~125,000 shipments in Jun-26; ambition 10% of shipments (20% in served pin codes).
International: no breakeven date; adjusted EBITDA loss cut 22% YoY in Q1FY27 to -7% of revenue (-25% in FY23).

Globalbees: Q1 revenue flat on a planned warehouse and inventory transition at one core brand (complete in Q2) and a ~2% hit from a change in Flipkart's settlement model; growth to return from Q3FY27. Core brands earned 4.3% adjusted EBITDA after corporate costs.
The AGM (22-Sep-2026) asked shareholders to vary the IPO objects (new warehouses; buying more of Globalbees' step-down subsidiaries) and to extend the use of unspent IPO money to FY2028-29.

noPromoter: Professionally managed: no identifiable promoter (FY26 annual report, note 22 and corporate governance report).
management: 5.2% holder; FY26 pay 114x the median employee (+4%)
board: MD & CEO, two investor nominees (SoftBank: Sanket Hattimattur; Mahindra: Saloni Jain Rana from 13-Feb-2026, replacing Puneet Renjhen) and four independent directors (G. Jagadeeswaran, Neeraj Sagar, Sujata Bogawat, Bala Deshpande). Statutory auditor: Walker Chandiok & Co LLP.
accounting: Adjusted EBITDA excludes ESOP cost (₹224 cr in FY26, 2.6% of revenue), exceptional items and Ind AS 103 B55 employment cost, and is before rent (Ind AS 116). Cash rent was ₹255 cr in FY26 (lease principal ₹151 cr + lease interest ₹103 cr), so pre-rent adjusted EBITDA (₹486 cr) is about twice the cash earnings after rent.

Exceptional items recur: ₹50 cr in FY25 and FY26 and ₹18 cr in Q1FY27 (Globalbees impairments and write-offs, a warehouse fire), partly offset by gains on remeasuring earn-outs owed to Globalbees brand founders.
Screener "Net Profit" is before minorities (FY26 -₹204 cr); the owners' share is -₹140 cr. Minorities own 48.32% of Globalbees.
₹388 cr owed to selling shareholders of Globalbees brands (consideration payable) sits in other financial liabilities: debt-like.
